name: spin_then_write_status_byte
description: Stores the input pointer advanced by two into a state field and writes an initial status byte. It then spins until a register byte becomes nonzero and writes a second status byte to the same field on each pass.

name: copy_record_into_descriptor_block
description: Follows an indirect table pointer to a record and copies its address and word fields into a descriptor block and two state fields. It then writes fixed control words and ends in the same spin loop that writes a status byte.

name: countdown_then_load_table_values
description: Decrements a countdown byte in the state record; when the result is negative it dispatches through an indirect jump table. Otherwise it reads table bytes at looked-up addresses, scales them into word values and stores them in the descriptor block, clamping negative byte values to zero.

name: scan_pairs_until_key_break
description: Sets two flag fields and writes a fixed control word, then saves the stream pointer and walks a table of byte pairs. It advances two bytes at a time while each entry equals one key byte and is not below a second limit; the exit path is not recoverable from the decompiled output.

name: load_scaled_levels_then_countdown
description: Reads stream bytes through lookup tables, adds fixed offsets, scales the results and stores them in state fields, then advances the stream pointer. It decrements a countdown and dispatches through an indirect jump when it goes negative, otherwise loading several table-derived words into the descriptor block.

name: walk_pairs_after_two_bytes
description: Stores the first stream byte in a state field and the second as a countdown, then walks two-byte entries. It jumps into the countdown-and-table routine when an entry is below a limit or differs from a key byte, and otherwise steps to the next pair.

name: walk_pairs_after_one_byte
description: Stores the first stream byte as a countdown and starts a pair walk at the next byte. It jumps into the countdown-and-table routine when an entry is below a limit or differs from a key byte, and otherwise steps to the next pair.

name: store_byte_then_dispatch_indirect
description: Stores the first stream byte in a state field, then calls a routine chosen by an indirect jump indexed from a stream byte and a register byte. The jump target table is not resolved in the decompiled output, so the callee cannot be identified from this code.

name: store_flag_then_dispatch_indirect
description: Stores the first stream byte in a state field, then calls a routine chosen by an indirect jump indexed from the second stream byte and a register byte. The jump table is not resolved in the decompiled output, so the callee cannot be named from this code.

name: store_relative_pointer_then_dispatch
description: Stores a signed word from the stream in a global cell and records the address of a base plus that word in a state field. It then calls a routine chosen by an indirect jump indexed from a stream byte and a register byte.

name: store_relative_pointer_second_slot
description: Stores a signed word from the stream in a global cell and records the address of a base plus that word in a different state field than its sibling routine. It then calls a routine chosen by an indirect jump indexed from a stream byte and a register byte.

name: dispatch_indirect_by_stream_byte
description: Calls a routine chosen by an indirect jump indexed from a stream byte and the high byte of a register, without storing anything itself. The jump table is not resolved in the decompiled output.

name: store_word_then_dispatch_indexed
description: Stores a signed word from the stream in a global cell, saves the stream position after it, and writes a flag byte to a state field. It then calls a routine through an indirect jump indexed by a byte at a state base plus that word.

name: copy_record_then_dispatch_indirect
description: Uses a stream word to locate a record through a base pointer and copies its address and word fields into a descriptor block and a state field. It writes fixed control words, then calls a routine chosen by an indirect jump indexed from a stream byte.

name: load_table_values_zero_count
description: Stores a flag byte and the stream pointer, then decrements a countdown. name: copy_bytes_recompute_destination
description: Copies one byte from a source stream to a destination, advances the source, and recomputes the destination as a base plus a signed word read just before the previous destination, saving it in a state field. The loop has no exit in the decompiled output.

name: countdown_load_table_or_dispatch

name: store_offset_then_dispatch_global

name: call_service_return_second_register

The decompiled code never assigns the first call's result to that variable, so the forward path is unreachable as shown.

name: stub_bootblock_entry_single_call

name: copy_block_after_trap_call
description: Writes a function address into a global cell, calls a system trap, and copies a block of 10652 bytes from one address to another. It then writes a stack-saved value, waits for a global word to clear, and sets it to a fixed value.

name: copy_block_then_release_wait

name: patch_constants_then_wait_flag

name: forward_call_to_unnamed_routine

name: reset_cia_state_bytes

name: service_cia_b_interrupt_flags

name: clear_pending_flag_bits

name: mask_button_state_and_call

name: store_sixteen_into_global

name: save_register_frame_after_wait

name: trap_then_set_global_value

description: Empty routine that returns immediately, with two callers. The facts list references to CIA port A and CIA port B registers and a custom chip base register, but no pseudo-code accesses them.

name: store_registers_into_record
description: Stores two data register values, a second word and a byte into a record at fixed offsets, with no calls. The routine ends after these four stores.

name: init_record_then_run_counter
description: Reads two saved fields from a record, writes a set of fixed control bytes into it and calls an unnamed routine with the values. It then runs a byte counter loop from zero to ten with unnamed calls on each step and clears a global.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Empty routine that returns immediately and is called by four unnamed routines. The pseudo-code contains no statements.

name: write_fixed_word_pattern_buffer
description: Stores a pointer and a count in a record, calls an unnamed routine, then writes a fixed 16-bit pattern into a buffer and several fixed 16-bit values into a record at offsets. It ends by calling another unnamed routine.

name: write_fixed_word_pattern_tail
description: Calls an unnamed routine, then writes the same fixed 16-bit pattern and record values as its neighbour into a buffer and a record. It ends by calling another unnamed routine.

name: poll_status_bit_with_timeout
description: Polls a status bit in a record up to fourteen times, calling an unnamed routine on each pass and waiting on a global flag. When the bit is set it sets two record fields and returns zero; when the retries run out it sets the same fields and returns an input register.

name: set_record_state_return_zero
description: Sets a word field to 2 and another word field to a fixed value in a record, then returns zero.

name: update_flag_bit_from_result
description: Calls an unnamed routine and folds bit zero of its byte result into a bit at an index taken from a data register, updating a byte at a base pointer. It then calls another unnamed routine.

name: copy_512_block_and_advance
description: Sets a global to 255, copies one 512-byte block from a source pointer into a destination computed from a byte index times 512 plus a fixed base, then advances the source pointer. It reduces a remaining count by 512, leaving zero when the count was 512 or less.

name: copy_512_byte_block_direct
description: Copies one 512-byte block from a source pointer to a destination pointer and advances both, then reduces a remaining count by 512, leaving zero when the count was 512 or less. It does not compute the destination itself.

name: scan_sync_pattern_then_copy
description: Scans a raw data stream for a fixed sync pattern, skipping repeated patterns. For each candidate it calls an unnamed routine to read a header value and compares it with a stored byte; on a match it copies up to 512 bytes of values into a buffer and updates the stored pointer and count. It returns a status code and minus seven when the scan window or retry counter runs out.

name: fill_buffer_from_routine_values
description: Fills a buffer with values from an unnamed routine and returns minus seven when a status value is negative. With at least 512 remaining it stores 128 longwords and reduces the count by 512; otherwise it stores longwords until the count is used up, writing any final partial longword byte by byte.

name: fill_buffer_small_count_first
description: Fills a buffer with values from an unnamed routine. With fewer than 512 remaining it stores longwords until the count is used up, writing any final partial longword byte by byte; otherwise it stores 128 longwords and reduces the count by 512.

name: write_rotated_bytes_to_memory
description: Writes a register value to memory one byte at a time, rotating the value by one byte after each write. The number of writes is a data register value plus four, and the routine returns zero.

name: combine_masked_bit_words
description: Returns a bitwise combination: a mask in one data register is ANDed with a word read through one pointer and ORed with the same mask ANDed with a word read through a second pointer that is doubled.

name: fill_128_longs_from_routine
description: Stores 128 longwords produced by an unnamed routine into a buffer, advances the pointer, and reduces a count by 512. It returns zero when the count reaches zero, and otherwise the last value produced.

name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns. It adds no logic of its own and has two callers.

name: set_low_bit_then_call
description: Sets bit zero of a byte at a fixed offset from a base pointer, then calls an unnamed routine.

name: write_word_bytes_wait_flag
description: Clears a global flag, writes the low and high bytes of a data register into two byte registers at fixed offsets from a base pointer, then spins until the global flag becomes nonzero.

name: update_control_byte_bits
description: Keeps the top three bits of one byte at a fixed offset from a base pointer while setting bit three, and writes the constant 130 into another byte at a fixed offset.

name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns. It adds no logic of its own and has six callers.

name: clear_flag_write_word_bytes
description: Calls an unnamed routine, clears a global flag, and writes the low and high bytes of a data register into two byte registers at fixed offsets from a base pointer.

name: scan_words_until_target_match
description: Loops reading 16-bit values through an unnamed routine until one equals a target stored in a frame field. Each pass reads a second value and calls a routine when its low bit is clear; the decompiled code always takes this branch. It makes two final calls after the loop.

name: scan_words_until_target_tail
description: Shares the target-scan loop of its neighbour without the first pair of calls. It calls four distinct unnamed routines and calls a routine on each pass when a low bit is clear.

name: scan_words_by_carry_branch
description: Loops reading 16-bit values through an unnamed routine until one equals a target stored in a frame field. Each pass calls a routine when a low bit is set or clear, depending on a carry flag input. It makes two final calls after the loop.

name: scan_words_until_clear_bit
description: Loops reading 16-bit values through an unnamed routine until one equals a target stored in a frame field. Each pass calls a routine when the low bit of a second value is clear. It makes two final calls after the loop.

name: clear_bit_in_control_byte
description: Rewrites a control byte at a fixed offset from a base pointer by masking it, setting a fixed set of bits, and clearing one bit chosen by the low five bits of a data register.

name: clear_control_bit_alt
description: Rewrites a control byte at a fixed offset from a base pointer by masking it, setting a different fixed set of bits, and clearing one bit chosen by the low five bits of a data register.

name: arm_bit_and_poll_status
description: When a slot byte indexed by a register is zero, calls an unnamed routine, marks the slot, and rewrites a control byte with bits set and one cleared. It then calls another unnamed routine and checks bit five of a status byte up to fifteen times, returning its input value.

name: pulse_control_byte_and_wait
description: Rewrites a control byte with a fixed set of bits and rewrites it again from its previous value, then calls an unnamed routine. It calls another routine twenty times in a countdown loop.

name: rewrite_control_byte_bit_mask
description: Rewrites a control byte at a fixed offset from a base pointer four times with bitwise masks and sets, ending with a fixed set of bits. It returns its input value.

name: clear_slot_set_control_bit
description: Clears a slot byte indexed by a data register, rewrites a control byte with bits set and one bit cleared and set from a mask chosen by that register, then calls an unnamed routine. It returns its input value.

name: compare_bytes_stop_at_marker
description: Compares up to four bytes of two data register values from the most significant byte down. It returns minus five when the second value's leading byte is an asterisk marker or all four bytes match, and otherwise returns zero.

name: call_routine_four_times
description: Calls one unnamed routine four times in a counted loop and returns.

name: toggle_field_bit_around_call
description: Saves a frame field, calls an unnamed routine for a value, stores that value with bit one toggled into the field, then calls another unnamed routine and restores the saved field.

name: set_control_bit_by_status
description: Rewrites a control byte with a fixed set of bits and one bit cleared by a register index. It writes 255 to one byte, and when bit two of a status byte is clear it writes zero there and 255 to another. It then sets the control bit, calls an unnamed routine, and returns the combined bit values.

name: poll_status_bits_arm_record
description: Polls status bits through several unnamed routines. When bit two of a status byte is set and further bit checks pass, it fills a record with a count of 18, a cleared byte and a fixed address value, calls unnamed routines twice, and returns early when the second check fails.

name: arm_record_when_status_set
description: When bit two of a status byte is set and a negative-flag input is clear, fills a record with fixed fields and calls unnamed routines before returning.

name: forward_call_to_unnamed_routine
description: Short routine that calls one unnamed routine and returns, with two callers. It adds no logic of its own.

name: clear_frame_word_by_index
description: Writes zero to a 16-bit slot in a frame array whose index comes from a data register offset by minus three, then returns.

name: read_frame_word_by_index
description: Returns a 16-bit word from a frame array whose index comes from a data register offset by minus three.

name: write_frame_word_by_index
description: Writes the data register word into a frame array slot whose index comes from a data register offset by minus three, then returns.

name: increment_frame_word_by_index
description: Adds one to a 16-bit frame array slot whose index comes from a data register offset by minus three, then returns the data register value.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Empty routine that returns immediately, with one caller. The pseudo-code contains no statements.

name: call_routine_four_in_row
description: Calls one unnamed routine four times in a row, then returns. The facts list references to CIA port registers, which the pseudo-code does not show directly.

name: verify_paired_routine_results
description: Calls two unnamed routines and compares their results; when they match it calls both again and compares once more. It returns the second value of the second pair on success and minus seven when either comparison fails.

name: xor_fold_longwords_masked
description: XORs together a run of longwords read through a pointer, with the run length taken from a data register divided by four, then returns that fold ANDed with a data register mask.

name: scan_status_bits_into_slots
description: When a global byte is zero, loops over four slot bytes, clearing each slot and setting it to 255 while calling unnamed routines, and sets a slot to zero when two status bits are both present. Afterwards it stores result values into the global one at a time while it stays zero, then marks the global's high byte. Otherwise it calls one routine.

name: store_results_into_global
description: When a flag input is clear, stores up to four result values from unnamed routines into a global cell one at a time while it stays zero. It then sets the global to 255 and returns the stack input value.

name: call_pair_when_global_set
description: When a global byte is nonzero, calls two unnamed routines, clears the global, and returns. Otherwise it returns without doing anything.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Empty routine that returns immediately, with one caller. The pseudo-code contains no statements.

name: fill_buffer_alternating_pattern
description: Writes 3332 longwords of an alternating bit pattern through a buffer pointer held in a frame record, four at a time. It then calls two unnamed routines eleven times in a loop.

name: write_register_block_words
description: Calls an unnamed routine, stores a frame field into a pointer slot, and writes a fixed set of 16-bit values at offsets from a base pointer. It calls one more unnamed routine and returns.

name: write_sync_pattern_then_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, writes a fixed 32-bit value made of two copies of a 16-bit sync pattern into a buffer, and calls another unnamed routine. It then runs a four-pass loop calling routines and makes eight more unnamed calls.

name: xor_fold_longwords_offset
description: XORs a run of longwords read through a pointer, starting from the first value, with the run length taken from a data register divided by four minus two. It returns that fold ANDed with a data register mask.

name: update_flag_bit_from_neighbour
description: Calls two unnamed routines, then clears bit seven of a byte at a pointer and sets it again when bit six is clear and bit zero of the preceding byte is clear.

name: update_flag_bit_no_calls
description: Clears bit seven of a byte at a pointer and sets it again when bit six is clear and bit zero of the preceding byte is clear. It makes no calls.

name: merge_bits_from_neighbour
description: Combines a data register mask and value with a shifted exclusive-or, clears the top bit when bit zero of the preceding byte is set, and stores the 32-bit result through a pointer.

name: program_transfer_registers_with_waits
description: Initialises a record with a fixed sentinel and zeroed fields, then stores pointer and count values into it. It writes a series of fixed 16-bit words to offsets and waits on a bit of a global flag between writes. The facts list a DMA control register read.

name: call_two_unnamed_routines
description: Calls two unnamed routines in sequence and returns, with one caller. It adds no logic of its own.

name: forward_call_to_unnamed_routine
description: Short routine that calls one unnamed routine and returns, with one caller. It adds no logic of its own.

name: set_control_bits_return_word
description: Sets a fixed set of bits in a control byte at a fixed offset from a base pointer and clears one bit chosen by a data register's low five bits. It returns the input word together with the updated working value.

name: set_control_bits_return_input
description: Sets a fixed set of bits in a control byte at a fixed offset from a base pointer and returns its word input unchanged.

name: wait_global_word_then_set
description: Spins until a global word reads zero, then sets it to 255 and returns.

name: store_argument_after_marker
description: Sets a global cell to 255, then copies a stack argument into it, and returns.

name: clear_global_cell
description: Sets a global cell to zero and returns.

name: stub_infinite_loop_only
description: Contains only an endless loop with no exit and no calls in the facts. It looks like a stub rather than a working routine.

name: set_global_sequence_then_call
description: Sets a global cell to one, increments it, calls one unnamed routine, then sets the cell to 255. The facts list an interrupt request register reference that the pseudo-code does not show directly.

name: initialise_custom_chip_registers
description: Stores unnamed routine addresses into a low-memory vector area, then writes display, colour, bitplane, DMA and CIA control registers with fixed values. It returns the fixed value 3199 after setting a final global.

name: set_copper_list_pointer
description: Writes its long argument to the first copper list pointer register and returns.

name: initialise_custom_chip_registers
description: Stores unnamed routine addresses into a low-memory vector area, then writes display, colour, bitplane, DMA and CIA control registers with fixed values. It returns the fixed value 3199 after setting a final global; the pseudo-code matches its neighbour, and the facts record four unnamed calls.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Empty routine that returns immediately, with one caller. The pseudo-code contains no statements.

name: wait_global_word_then_set
description: Spins until a global word reads zero, then sets it to a fixed value and returns.

name: clear_global_cell
description: Sets a global cell to zero and returns.

name: stub_infinite_loop_only
description: Contains only an endless loop with no exit and no calls in the facts. It looks like a stub rather than a working routine.

name: set_global_sequence_then_call
description: Sets a global cell to one, increments it, calls one unnamed routine, then sets the cell to 255.

name: preserve_global_around_call
description: Calls an unnamed routine, saves a global cell, calls another unnamed routine, then restores the saved value.

name: store_offset_sum_then_call
description: Stores the low word of a long argument in a global cell, adds three constants totalling 48000 to it, then calls one unnamed routine.

name: initialise_custom_chip_registers
description: Stores a fixed word into eight low-memory slots and sets two global values, then writes display, colour, bitplane, DMA and CIA control registers with fixed values. It returns the fixed value 3199.

name: set_copper_list_pointer
description: Writes its long argument to the first copper list pointer register and returns. The facts record a much longer chip register list and 78 instructions, which the pseudo-code does not show.

name: stub_empty_return_routine
description: Empty routine that returns immediately, with one caller. The pseudo-code contains no statements.

name: run_until_zero_result
description: Initialises three global cells, then repeatedly calls two unnamed routines and a third routine that returns a value, looping until that value is zero.

name: run_until_zero_result_variant
description: Initialises three global cells with a different starting value for one of them, then repeatedly calls two unnamed routines and a third routine that returns a value, looping until that value is zero.

name: scale_packed_nibble_table
description: Rescales sixteen packed 12-bit words, each holding three 4-bit fields, by a factor taken from a global cell, writing the results into a global table. It then steps a counter and sets a flag from its result.

name: run_nested_call_loops
description: Saves two global cells and a state word, calls unnamed routines, then runs nested counted loops that call routines five times per step. An extra inner loop runs when a flag is set, and the routine calls an empty stub at the end.

name: poll_values_until_zero_loop
description: Calls several unnamed routines, reads a field from a record, and fetches another value when its low bit is clear. When the fetched values are nonzero it loops calling an unnamed routine until each returned value is zero, with no exit condition in the decompiled output.

name: xor_into_longword_at_pointer
description: XORs a data register value into the longword at a pointer and returns.

name: copy_block_or_strided_words
description: When a flag bit is clear, copies 2000 blocks of four longwords between two buffers. Otherwise it calls two unnamed routines and copies a window of 16-bit words into a buffer with offsets of 4000, 8000 and 12000 words, clamping the row count to nineteen.
